name: London Liquidity Sweep — Test Playbook
description: Comprehensive dummy strategy used to test the visual playbook editor, timeline journal, immutable snapshots, specialized fields, and Edge Coach analytics.
changeNote: Created a complete test strategy covering every lifecycle stage and supported field type.

rules.label: Why should this edge exist?
rules.helpText: Explain the repeatable market behavior behind the strategy.
rules.placeholder: London takes overnight liquidity before expanding toward the opposing objective…

rules.label: Suitable markets
rules.helpText: Select every market validated for this playbook.

evidence.caption: Reference context: price approaches prior-day liquidity while the higher-timeframe bias remains bullish.

rules.label: Higher-timeframe bias
rules.helpText: Use Daily and H4 structure to establish direction.

rules.label: Analysis date
rules.helpText: Date on which the pre-market plan was prepared.

rules.label: Planned entry window
rules.helpText: Local start time of the intended execution window.

evidence.caption: Valid example: liquidity is swept into the marked order block before displacement creates an entry imbalance.
Invalid example: entry occurs in the middle of the range without a liquidity sweep or higher-timeframe location.

rules.label: Required liquidity was swept
rules.helpText: Confirm price traded through the documented liquidity objective before entry.

rules.label: Setup confirmations
rules.helpText: Select every observable confirmation present on the chart.

rules.label: Location explanation
rules.helpText: Summarize why the location is meaningful.
rules.placeholder: Discount H1 order block below Asian low

rules.label: Entry model
rules.helpText: Choose the exact entry model used.

rules.label: Planned entry price
rules.helpText: Record the planned price before execution.

rules.label: Account risk
rules.helpText: Maximum account equity placed at risk.

rules.label: Monetary risk
rules.helpText: Maximum planned loss in account currency.

rules.label: Stop distance
rules.helpText: Distance between entry and invalidation.

rules.label: Planned risk-to-reward
rules.helpText: Enter 2 for a planned 1:2 trade.

rules.label: Entry executed as planned
rules.helpText: Confirm price, timing, direction, and size matched the plan.

rules.label: Entry slippage
rules.helpText: Absolute difference between planned and filled price.

rules.label: Trade duration
rules.helpText: Minutes from entry until final exit.

rules.label: Management followed the plan
rules.helpText: No unplanned stop movement, partial, or fear-based close.

rules.label: Exit reason
rules.helpText: Select the event that ended the trade.

rules.label: Realized result
rules.helpText: Final result expressed as an R multiple; losses may be negative.

rules.label: Execution quality
rules.helpText: Rate compliance with the complete playbook from 1 to 10.

rules.label: Main lesson
rules.helpText: Write the repeatable lesson, not merely a description of the outcome.
rules.placeholder: What should be repeated or avoided next time?

rules.label: Does the playbook require revision?
rules.helpText: Choose Yes only when evidence suggests the documented strategy—not execution—needs adjustment.
